description: Dependency updates of the deployment configuration through the Mend Renovate GitHub App: the upstream charts of argocd/apps/components.json and of argocd/bootstrap.json, the image pins of base/, the actions of .github/workflows/ and the commit of the code repository whose checker the workflow runs.

Every update is a pull request a code owner reads and merges by hand: no automerge. A release is proposed only once it is 3 days old, because a hijacked release is usually pulled within hours (trivy, March 2026); vulnerability alerts skip that wait and the schedule.
envs/ is left alone: its images belong to the promote pull requests, its overlays and charts.yaml to people. An update of base/ reaches stg and prd together.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Opened at once, outside the schedule and without minimumReleaseAge. Needs the repository's Dependency graph and Dependabot alerts.

helm-values.description: The values files of the platform charts in base/, which are not named values.yaml. Their image pins are repository + tag: <version>@sha256:<digest>, or an image: string with both. base/services/ has no image: the release images are in envs/<env>/images/.

customManagers.description: Chart values whose image key does not end in 'image', so helm-values does not see them (KEDA, Tempo): the annotation, then 'tag: <version>@sha256:<digest>'.

Prometheus and Alertmanager of kube-prometheus-stack: the annotation, 'version: <version>', 'image:', 'tag: <version>@sha256:<digest>'. Unless version is set, the chart writes tag into the object's version field, which the operator parses as a version, so version holds the same version without the digest. Renovate's regex engine (RE2) has no backreferences, so the match cannot require the two to be equal: version and digest are read from tag, the image actually pulled, and the template writes version and tag from the same new version, so every update, a digest-only one included, makes them equal again.
Charts of the platform components from a Helm repository: repo, chart and version of each entry of components.json and of argocd/bootstrap.json (Argo CD itself, same fields).
Charts of the platform components from an OCI registry (repo oci://<registry>/<path>): an OCI artifact, looked up as <registry>/<path>/<chart> on the docker datasource.

The commit of the code repository whose deploy/ci/gitops-check.sh the check workflow runs (CHECKER_COMMIT), with a '# renovate: datasource=git-refs depName=<repository> branch=<branch>' line right above: the newest commit of that branch.

packageRules.description: chore(deps) for every update; vulnerabilityAlerts above turns a vulnerability fix into fix(deps).
Digest-only updates (an image rebuilt under the same tag) not covered by a group below: one weekly pull request.
GitHub Actions, pinned to a full commit SHA with the version in a comment: one pull request for non-major updates. A major gets its own pull request, since a workflow may need changes for it.
Each chart is one pull request together with the image pins of its values file: a chart bump does not move a pin, since a pin overrides the chart's default.
prBodyNotes: A chart or a platform image changed: check it on a cluster before merging: make k8s-up and make k8s-smoke in the code repository with this branch's clone (SVP_GITOPS_DIR).

Kyverno changed: run make drill-k8s-supplychain in the code repository before merging. Policy svp-images is an ImageValidatingPolicy, and the health check of Argo CD (base/argo-cd.yaml) reads its status.conditionStatus.ready; check both still hold in the new version.

packageRules.description: The broker image of svp-data (a chart of the code repository) and of compose there moves with the redpanda chart; Renovate of the code repository proposes those, keep the versions in step.
The Collector image of base/otel-collector.yaml is also pinned in the code repository (compose, OTELCOL_IMAGE of its Makefile): keep the versions in step.

The checker commit: one pull request whenever main of the code repository moves, read with the code repository's log before merging (the new commit's deploy/ci/gitops-check.sh checks this tree from then on).
